newsitem.title: USA: Kyzen expects to meet '96 analyst estimates.
newsitem.headline: Kyzen expects to meet '96 analyst estimates.

text.p: Kyzen Corp on Thursday said 1996 research and development budgets were heightened for its development of process controls and broadened-reach chemistries but it expects to meet current market expectations.
The specialty chemical company said it planned to release 1996 results in late February.
Company officials were not available for comment.
The company also said it will introduce the first of a projected family of process control devices for use in precision cleaning in high-technology manufacturing environments.

The system -- PCS -- maintains chemical/water balances in aqueous-based cleaning machines without the intervention of an operator or quality inspector. Kyzen President and Chief Executive Officer Kyle Doyel said that although a limited number of PCS units have already been sold, the product will be formally introduced at the upcoming Nepcon West '97 electronics trade show in Anaheim, Calif., Feb. 25-27.
